title: Cover Drive En Espanol (Chas McIvor)
style: rockabilly two step jangle electric guitar slap back echo walking bass brushed drums hiccup vocal fast beat 134bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections fifties pop swing spanish guitar accent
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
Now son, I am going to say this in Spanish
I do not speak Spanish
But somehow it sounds right

[Verse 1]
Ball pitches on a good length, just outside off
Front foot forward, head over the ball
Bat comes down from high, late wrists through
Cover drive through the gap, that is what you do

[Spanish Verse]
La cabeza sobre el balon, pie adelante firme
El bate llega tarde, sigue alto el giro
Dobla las rodillas, ojos en la costura
La puerta de atras, ese es el camino seguro

[Chas reacts spoken]
I do not know what he just said son
But it SOUNDED like good advice
Head over the ball. Late. Every time.

[Chorus]
Cover drive front foot, head over ball
Bat comes late and follow-through tall
Cabeza sobre el balon, alto el giro
Cover drive, that is cricketing glory

[Verse 2]
Dont plant too early, ball reads your weight
Stay patient, stay side-on, let it come late
The bat face open toward cover point
Follow through high, that is the whole joint

[Spanish Bridge]
No te adelantes, espera el momento
Paciencia y lado, ese es el fundamento
La cara del bate hacia el punto de cobertura
Sigue alto, esa es la buena aventura

[Chas spoken]
See, that is EXACTLY what I have been saying
In any language, the answer is the same
Head over the ball son

[Chorus]
Cover drive front foot, head over ball
Bat comes late and follow-through tall
Cabeza sobre el balon, alto el giro
Cover drive, that is cricketing glory

[Outro]
Head over ball son
En cualquier idioma
Thats my boy
